cues.prompt: Instrumental dark thriller underscore, minimal and almost subliminal. A single low analog synth drone, very quiet, slowly evolving, cold and claustrophobic, like the air inside a closed car at night. After about 11 seconds a slow, soft sub-bass pulse enters, around 55 BPM, like a distant heartbeat, and continues steadily under the drone to the end. No melody, no chords changes, no percussion hits, no risers, no vocals. Sparse, tense, low register only, steady level throughout.

A single low, dissonant orchestral string swell: cellos and basses holding a tense minor-second cluster, swelling slowly from silence to a strained, uneasy peak and sustaining. Cinematic thriller ending, dark, no percussion, no melody, no reverb tail.
cues.mix_note: Music sting (made with the sound-effect model for exact length). Under l10. Cut hard to silence at 31.7 on the cut to black; do not let the tail ring.
